name: Lefun Dollar Cube 3x3
description: Cash in on a clever twist with the Lefun Dollar Cube 3x3! This novelty cube features two front-side prints of a U.S. one-dollar bill and one back-side print, creating a uniquely eye-catching puzzle both scrambled and solved. Each face is seamlessly printed for a crisp, full-bill look that adds a creative challenge beyond colors alone.
